submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency (91.97%) among all algorithm and threshold combinations tested, meeting the goal of maximizing signal efficiency within the allowed threshold range. This threshold is within the required 20–60 GeV window, and Algorithm-L1 is among the permitted candidates. The solution aligns with all specified constraints, and typical design documents support that Algorithm-L1 is deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware (see candidate_specs.md).
